pages.title: A Cloud to Call Home
pages.text: Place a Dried Ghast and right-click a Ghastling with a snowball.

pages.title: A Cloud to Call Home
pages.text: Begin the native sky companion route without a free creature reward.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Keep the Dried Ghast in water and let it become a Ghastling. Snowballs support growth. No fixed waiting timer or successful growth is checked by this introduction.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Find a Dried Ghast or craft one and keep it waterlogged. Hydrate it through stages until it becomes a Ghastling.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Feed Snowballs to a Ghastling while it grows. Accelerate growth into a Happy Ghast.
